name: Goal Planner
description: Map your messy thoughts and targets into a beautiful, visual monthly calendar.

howToUse:
1. Select the target Month and Year.
2. Dump all your goals and tasks in the text area (e.g., 'Gym on Mondays, pay rent on the 5th').
3. Click BUILD to generate the visual schedule.
4. Save it as an image to use as your wallpaper or reminder.
features:
• Smart Date Parsing
• Visual Calendar Grid
• Export to PNG
